title: Watersound 19 Creek Bridge Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Short walk or bike ride to the private beach- Lookout tower and wet bar on the third floor with 360-degree views of the Gulf and WaterSound community- Located in The Bridges district of WaterSound- Conveniently located to renowned cuisine and shopping along scenic Highway 30A- Surrounded by scenic nature trails- Professionally decorated- 4 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*This property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Embrace extraordinary coastal living at 19 Creek Bridge Way, a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home located in The Bridges district of WaterSound. From plush bedding to sunny porches, guests can enjoy comfort throughout any space of the home. In addition to an enviable location in WaterSound where scenic nature trails beckon, it's only a short walk or bike ride to the private beach.On the first level, a serene, screened porch with outdoor lounge chairs is located at the front of the home and shaded by surrounding trees to allow for plenty of privacy. Inside, there is a mud room to store beach gear, casual sitting room, and 3 bedrooms. The first guest bedroom offers 2 queen beds with a shared hallway bathroom. The second guest bedroom has a queen bed with a private bathroom and access to the porch. Enhanced with folding French doors, a cozy primary suite is down the hall with a king bed, and 2 twin beds with a spacious bathroom featuring a clawfoot tub and walk-in shower.Up the stairs, the second floor leads to a great room joined by the chef's custom kitchen. Accented with rustic blue cabinetry, quartz countertops, and stainless-steel appliances, the kitchen epitomizes chic coastal living. Guests can sit at the breakfast bar or dining table for combined seating for 11. The living area is adjacent to the second-story porch, which includes more outdoor lounge seating and overlooks the neighborhood. An interior staircase takes you to a lookout tower and wet bar on the third floor with 360-degree views of the Gulf and WaterSound community!The home's carriage house is adjacent to the main home and connected by an outdoor seating area. With a king and twin bed, the carriage house can sleep 3 additional guests and has a private bathroom and kitchenette.As an award-winning destination on the Emerald Coast of Florida, WaterSound's boutique resort community features several neighborhood pools, exceptional golf courses, and pristine, unobstructed beaches that stretch several miles. The Hub and Rosemary Beach are just a short ride away along Scenic Highway 30A with renowned cuisine and shopping. Don't miss your chance to stay in this beautiful WaterSound home!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed with 2 Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Shared Common Area Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

DETAILS: Embrace extraordinary coastal living at 19 Creek Bridge Way, a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home located in The Bridges district of WaterSound. From plush bedding to sunny porches, guests can enjoy comfort throughout any space of the home. In addition to an enviable location in WaterSound where scenic nature trails beckon, it's only a short walk or bike ride to the private beach. With a king and twin bed, the carriage house can sleep 3 additional guests and has a private bathroom and kitchenette. As an award-winning destination on the Emerald Coast of Florida, WaterSound's boutique resort community features several neighborhood pools, exceptional golf courses, and pristine, unobstructed beaches that stretch several miles. The Hub and Rosemary Beach are just a short ride away along Scenic Highway 30A with renowned cuisine and shopping. Don't miss your chance to stay in this beautiful WaterSound home!
